sources.snippet: Example Model for BatterySwapAI 2026 This repository shows how to create a solution for the BatterySwapAI 2026 challenge. It contains working example code that can be submitted as-is, along with tools to check the solution before submitting.

sources.title: Transformer (deep learning) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: One set of matrices is called an attention head, and each layer in a transformer model has multiple attention heads. While each attention head attends to the tokens that are relevant to each token, multiple attention heads allow the model to do this for different definitions of "relevance".

sources.title: Attention (machine learning) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Attention mechanism, overview In machine learning, attention is a method that determines the importance of each component in a sequence relative to the other components in that sequence. In natural language processing, importance is represented by "soft" weights assigned to each word in a sentence.
